note: Both sets suffer from fragmentation errors where entities like 'on-axis telescope' are parsed as 'n-axis telescope' or 'axis telescope'. However, Set B correctly extracts the Lynx 10 m parameter as 'focal length', whereas Set A incorrectly labels it as 'size' of the mirror assembly and misses the focal length property entirely. Set B is preferred for accurately capturing this critical engineering specification despite having similar noise levels elsewhere.
